The content of arch/20260925-057-carried-state @ a6dcf6ab has a merge path, stated.
Rulings D16, D17, D18 and D19 appear verbatim; a grep for a distinctive phrase finds each.
HANDOVER.md's stamp names main's tip and the branch main, with the count re-derived and equal to the suite's.
§3.2's manifest block matches the actual pyproject.toml, and the response states plainly whether it remains a hand copy.
tests/test_handover_truth.py asserts branch existence, main-ancestry and count match; each demonstrated by breaking it.
The PR-body reporting regression is recorded without blame, with D15 cited.
Suite passes; count reported before and after, and the after-count equals the stamped value.
assumptions: The executor can open a pull request. If the capability is absent, that is the finding and must be reported, not worked around.
The -057 branch's commits are still present on the remote and were not deleted.
constraints: Documentation, channel rule and one guard. $0.00. No code, run or key.

FIRST, AND THIS IS THE PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: establish a merge path for the branch this command runs on. If a PR exists, record its number. If none exists, OPEN ONE. A PUSHED claim with no PR is STRANDED (Ruling D16) and this command must not itself be STRANDED. If capability to open a PR is absent, say so plainly — that is the finding, not a reason to skip it.

SECOND: bring arch/20260925-057-carried-state @ a6dcf6ab to main. It carries §65's D15 third exhibit, the CARRIED state in .orchestration/README.md, and a HANDOVER.md stamp correction. State how — a PR from that branch, or its content reproduced — and do not force-push or rewrite it.

'Ruling D16 — PUSHED requires a merge path. A branch with committed work and no pull request is not PUSHED; it is STRANDED, and the response must name it so. D15 states the channel state of record changes only at merge, so a state from which no merge can occur is not a state the channel can reason about. delivery_state must carry the pull request number wherever one exists, and a response claiming PUSHED with no pull request is a BLOCKED-class report, not a DONE. First exhibit: ARCH-20260925-057 at a6dcf6ab, pushed 2026-09-25T05:18:47Z, no pull request at the time of this ruling. Second exhibit: the same branch still had no pull request at 01632c97, three and a half hours later.'

'Ruling D17 — carriage may carry an instruction; it may not carry work. Carriage is legitimate as transport: an instruction is a message, and moving it to main without executing it is honest provided the CARRIED state is named. The permission has a boundary: carriage must never carry an artifact that asserts work was done. ARCH-20260923-053 and -054 are instructions, so 4ab956f8 was correct. A response file claiming DONE is not transport and travels only with the work it describes, on the same branch, as the protocol already requires.'

'Ruling D18 — a stamp must name main and an ancestor of main, or it is not a stamp. The freshness guard introduced for B22 asserts that the named commit resolves and is an ancestor of the commit under test. At main 01632c97 the HANDOVER stamp named commit 2e75232 on branch arch/20260923-053-actionable-terminal — a branch that no longer exists. Resolvability and ancestry are both insufficient: the guard must also assert the named BRANCH exists, and the named commit is an ancestor of MAIN specifically. Third exhibit of B22, and the first the guard could have caught and did not.'

'Ruling D19 — a document labelled verbatim is a claim, and claims are guarded. HANDOVER.md section 3.2 labels its pyproject.toml block verbatim and shows sqlalchemy>=2.0.36, while the B1 row in the same document records that the manifest was changed to sqlalchemy[asyncio]>=2.0.36 after merged-main CI failed. The block is a stale hand copy. Either generate and guard it, or stop labelling it verbatim. Convention 24, applied to the section that most invites hand-copying.'

REPAIR THE STAMP: set HANDOVER.md's HEAD to main's tip and its Branch to main, and set the test count to the value the suite reports on this command's branch (convention 24 — re-derive, do not copy). If the count differs from 986, STOP and name the difference rather than stamping what you see.

REPAIR §3.2: make the pyproject.toml block match the actual manifest. If it cannot be generated, correct it by hand AND say in the response that it remains a hand copy — do not silently make it accurate and leave the label.

EXTEND THE GUARD: tests/test_handover_truth.py must assert (a) the named branch exists, (b) the named commit is an ancestor of main, (c) the test count matches the suite. Prove it by breaking all three, and quote what it said for each.

RECORD the reporting regression without attributing blame: pull:#71's body carries neither a delivery-state section nor a branch-hygiene line, where pull:#69 carried both. State that the delivery_state field is required by D15 and that the reporting shape should not get leaner as the work gets better.

RECORD the advisor's channel account: this is the fourth command in one class — -053 and -054 CARRIED without execution, -057 PUSHED without a merge path, -058 REPROPOSED because its objective was unmet. State that the class is now named and mechanically detectable, and ask whether the detection should be automated.
DO NOT re-issue -054 in this command. It is the next command and is issued separately.
Every count re-derived against the tree (convention 24).
